calls.reason: The 2026 AI Index reports benchmark gains across language, reasoning, coding and math, and METR's time horizons keep doubling, which it attributes to greater reliability. The 2024 Nature paper is a caveat but not a reversal.
The deadline of January 2028 has not passed. The only evidence is Meta's V-JEPA 2 announcement, which gives no field-wide share of AI effort.
Neither reliable physical reasoning nor reliable psychological reasoning has been reached, and AGI has not arrived. The packet contains no evidence about the order or the manner of arrival.
Whether these were 'great answers' is a judgment with no threshold. A 2021 survey of open causal-representation problems and DreamerV3's partial world-model success point in different directions.

Evaluations from before the post show GPT-3 more than 30 points behind humans on social reasoning and brittle causal reasoning on BIG-bench. Chain-of-thought gains challenge only a reading of complete absence, not 'remotely close to AGI'.

No independently validated AGI with a documented architecture exists. OpenAI's own GPT-6 Astra disclosure and the SenseNova evaluation say nothing about whether explicit knowledge or cognitive models are necessary.
